the loss of heterozygositiy on chromosome 11q is associated with the progression from typical carcinoids to more aggressive atypical forms.
the loss of 11q13 region, harboring MEN1 gene, is a common event in atypical carcinoid and that the loss of this region is associated with the aggressiveness of the tumors.
